name: cospi
comment: Sig: r = cospi(x). Accurate cos(pi*x) via exact int64 octant reduction + single-double SLEEF cospik polynomial (third_party/sleef, BSL-1.0), replacing the naive cos(pi*x). Branches: integer -> +/-1 (r1 cospi(0)=1, r5 cospi(1)=-1, r6 cospi(2)=1); half-integer -> exact 0 (r2 x=0.5, r3 x=1.5, r12 x=-0.5); large half-integer 1e7+0.5 -> 0 (r4); accurate 1/3=0.5 (r7), 0.25=sqrt2/2 (r8), 1/6=sqrt3/2 (r9), 1/7 (r10); generic 0.1 (r11). <=2 ULP vs MATLAB R2025b (exact at the closed-form points).
